learning_outcomes.text: Understand the concept of power control through switching.
Understand the basic operation principles of power semiconductors used in line frequency power conversion circuits and can perform basic calculations.
Can identify the basic rectifier topologies used in line-frequency converters and can analyze these converters.
Can design rectifier circuits to meet certain requirements and can select power devices considering realistic conditions.
Know the meaning and ideal values of certain parameters to evaluate the performance of converters.

syllabus_topics: Application areas of power electronics and introduction basic principles
Review of basic techniques used in power electronics (Fourier analysis, transient circuit analysis)
Operation principles and characteristics of diodes and thyristors
Analysis of basic rectifier circuits, Definition and calculation of performance parameters.
Analysis of single phase diode rectifiers
Analysis of single phase thyristor rectifiers
Analysis of three phase rectifiers: Uncontrolled rectifiers
Analysis of three phase rectifiers: Controlled rectifiers
Analysis of three phase rectifiers: Semi-controlled rectifiers
Unbalanced operation and solution of transformers at the converter input
bibliography: 1- Power Electronics: Converters, Applications, and Design; N. Mohan, Tore Undeland, William P. Robbins
2- Elements of Power Electronics, Philip T. Krein, Oxford University Press
1- Power Electronics: circuits, devices, and applications; M. Rashid, Prentice-Hall, 2013
